sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding kalwisz: bearing brackets in red.
Your rolling quality to 2026Q3 stands at 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Electric power generation producer prices (PPI-D351) changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
We have reduced the chargeback to EUR 0 per complaint.
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around chargebacks, quality commitment.
We will pay every invoice on its due date, without exception.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 15,900 pcs per year over 12 months.
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
